proposals: MoSPI should publish an official linking factor between the old CPI series and the base-2024 series for every state, so year-on-year inflation can be computed for 2025 rather than only from January 2026 onward, as this bulletin found.

The Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT should publish official linking factors between the 2011-12 and 2022-23 WPI bases, by major group, so users can read a continuous fourteen-year index level instead of comparing only inflation rates across the rebasing.

The Office of the Economic Adviser should flag each monthly WPI index value as provisional or final in its downloadable files, with the revision date, so outliers such as the April 2026 jump to 167 can be checked against the revised final estimate without searching press releases.

MoSPI should show a last-updated date and latest available period for every series served through its data API, so users can see when a series lags — as the foreign-exchange reserves series did, returning June 2025 when 2026 was requested.
